## What this changes

Say what moved and why, in the way the change would be described to
someone who has to decide whether to take it. A list of edited files is
already in the diff.

## How it was checked

- [ ] `node tests/standards_test.mjs` passes
- [ ] `node tests/palette_test.mjs` passes
- [ ] `Rscript tests/run_tests.R` passes
- [ ] `node tests/dom_test.mjs` passes
- [ ] The app was opened and the changed screen was used

## Things worth a second look

Anything left unfinished, any decision that could reasonably have gone
the other way, and anything the tests do not cover. A pull request that
says nothing here is usually one that has not been read closely by the
person who wrote it.

## Colors and writing

If a color token moved, the palette audit result is the evidence, not
the screenshot. If user facing text changed, it follows the house
standard: no em or en dashes, no contractions, American English.
